body:
Triage: routed `domain:devx`, queued (**Task**, docs-only). Fix surface is `content/docs/releases/` status lines for v9/v12/v14 — release-owned, so a dedicated docs-only PR, ⛔ never a rider on code. Worked precedent for the shape: PR #8912.

Sequencing note for the devx seat: this card is an input to **#8892's design** (the A/B/C fork recorded on this card). ⛔ Do not dispatch #8892 without its dispatch prompt naming this card. No `pm:blocked` in either direction — the A/B/C choice belongs to #8892's own design, and this card is dispatchable independently.

Scope guard from the card, worth repeating in the dispatch: fixing a status line may surface undocumented minor content — that is #8917's (decision-gated) territory, ⛔ not silent expansion here.

Size/model suggestion: S mechanical, sonnet.

Triage: this comment is from the triage seat (scheduled run) — no claim.

## ✅ Maintainer ruling — scope settled, this card narrows to **v14 only**

**Maintainer, 2026-08-15, verbatim, untranslated:**

> v14 之前的版本都不用管

⇒ Versions **before v14** are out of scope. v9 and v12 are **not** to be fixed, and their staleness is now an **accepted state**, not an open defect.

### Reading of the boundary, stated so it can be corrected in one word

I read 「v14 之前」 as **v13 and earlier — v14 itself remains in scope.** Two reasons, and the second is why I did not resolve the ambiguity toward the cheaper option:

1. v14 is the **only** page in this set that is **internally contradictory**: `v14.mdx:6` says `current: 14.5.0`, while `index.mdx` already says `(final release: 14.8.0)`. A reader sees both claims on the same site, and one of them is wrong regardless of whether anyone runs v14.
2. It still uses the **current-series** phrasing for a long-closed line — the exact defect class #8886/#8912 just fixed for v16.

⚠️ If the intent was "v14 and earlier", this is a one-line correction and the card closes `not planned` instead. ⛔ I have not assumed that reading, because it is the one that produces no work, and picking the no-work reading of an ambiguous instruction is how scope quietly disappears.

### What this card now is

| page | says | last tag | disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `v9.mdx:6` | published at 9.0.0 | `9.11.0` | ⛔ **out of scope** — maintainer ruling |
| `v12.mdx:6` | published at 12.0.0 | `12.6.0` | ⛔ **out of scope** — maintainer ruling |
| `v13.mdx:6` | published at 13.0.0 | `13.0.0` | ✅ accurate anyway |
| **`v14.mdx:6`** | ***current:* 14.5.0** | **`14.8.0`** | **⇒ the only work left on this card** |

**Fix shape**: docs-only, and `content/docs/releases/` is **release-owned** ⇒ a **dedicated docs-only PR**, ⛔ never a rider on code. **PR #8912 is the worked precedent** — status line rewritten as shipped, index entry already correct here so likely untouched.

⚠️ Carry the trap #8912 hit: fixing a status line honestly can surface that a minor's *content* is documented nowhere (that is #8917 for the v16 line). ⛔ Do not let "correct the status line" silently become "write the missing release notes" — report it if you find it.

### Consequence for #8892 — the gate can now be scoped

This ruling is what that card was blocked on. Recorded there; summary: the gate covers **v14 and later**, the cutoff is stated **in the gate's own failure text**, and this card's v14 fix lands **before** the gate so `main` never goes red on it.

## ⛔ SUPERSEDES my comment above (`5305269360`) — closing `not planned`

**Maintainer, 2026-08-15, verbatim, untranslated — this is the operative ruling:**

> 只负责 v16 以后的，需要的话之前的版本删除也可以的

⇒ **Only v16 onward is maintained.** Everything this card is about — v9, v12, **and v14** — is out of scope.

⚠️ My comment above read the earlier 「v14 之前的版本都不用管」 as leaving **v14 in scope**, and argued for fixing it because the page contradicts its own index entry. **That reading is now moot.** The cutoff is v16, not v14. ⛔ Do not implement anything from that comment — it is superseded in full, and I am leaving it visible rather than editing it so the correction is legible.

### Disposition

**Closed `not planned`.** The staleness of `v9.mdx`, `v12.mdx` and `v14.mdx` is now an **accepted state**, ⛔ not an open defect and ⛔ not a baselined one. Nobody is expected to fix them, and no gate should complain about them.

### ⚠️ The deletion option is recorded, not taken

The ruling also permits deleting the pre-v16 pages (「需要的话之前的版本删除也可以的」). ⛔ **Not exercised here**, deliberately, and this is the part worth writing down for whoever revisits it:

- Deletion is **not** a one-line docs change. `pnpm check:release-notes` asserts *"every released major has a curated, navigable page"* — deleting v9–v15 would make that gate **red** unless the gate is updated in the same breath. A "just delete them" PR discovers this the hard way.
- The pages are **public URLs**. Removing them breaks inbound links for anyone still on those lines.
- `content/docs/releases/` is **release-owned** ⇒ any deletion is a **dedicated docs-only PR**, ⛔ never a rider on code.

⇒ Deletion is a **real option with a real cost**, and it is permitted rather than requested. If someone wants it, it is a fresh card that must name the `check:release-notes` coupling in its scope. ⛔ It should not be smuggled in as cleanup on some other card.

### What this unblocks

**#8892 is now dispatchable with no prerequisite at all.** Its gate scopes to **v16+**, and both in-scope pages are already correct — v16 by PR #8912 and v17 by PR #8882, both merged today. Recorded there.
